title: Resume and cover letter tailoring per job posting
description: Tailor a resume and cover letter to a specific job posting and check the result against the posting's actual requirements before finalizing.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: resume-tailoring
  title: Resume and cover letter tailoring per job posting
  description: Tailor a resume and cover letter to a specific job posting and check the result against the posting's actual requirements before finalizing.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a resume and cover letter tailored to a specific job posting that credibly matches its stated requirements.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 2, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Base resume, cover letter, and job posting
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: "The candidate's base resume and cover letter, plus the full text of the job posting to tailor them to." }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: tailor
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Tailor resume and cover letter
      role: Resume and cover letter writer who tailors materials to a specific job posting.
      prompt: Rewrite the resume bullet points and cover letter to foreground the candidate's genuine experience that matches the posting's stated requirements and keywords. Do not fabricate experience, titles, or skills the candidate does not have; reorder and rephrase existing content instead.
      capabilities: { skills: [writing-editing], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [resume, coverLetter], properties: { resume: { type: string }, coverLetter: { type: string } } }
    - id: fit-check
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Keyword and requirement fit check
      role: Independent evaluator who checks tailored materials against a job posting's actual requirements.
      prompt: Compare the tailored resume and cover letter against the job posting's required and preferred qualifications and keywords. Identify any requirement that is not addressed and any claim that is not supported by the base materials. Return a score, a pass/fail verdict, and specific reasons.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [score, passed, reasons], properties: { score: { type: number }, passed: { type: boolean }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.8 }
    - id: tailor-loop
      kind: loop
      name: Tailoring revision loop
      config: { body: [tailor, fit-check], exitCondition: "fit-check.passed == true", maxIterations: 2, onExhausted: warn }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Tailored resume and cover letter
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: tailor, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: tailor, to: fit-check, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: fit-check, to: result, kind: control, condition: "passed == true" }
    - { id: e4, from: fit-check, to: tailor-loop, kind: control, condition: "passed == false" }
    - { id: e5, from: tailor-loop, to: result, kind: control, condition: loop_exit }
    - { id: e6, from: tailor-loop, to: result, kind: control, condition: loop_exhausted }
